required_conditions: all intermediate L compositions remain admissible or legally recoupled
Q compositions preserve Ref(.) equivalence or cross declared legal boundaries
residue context is consistent across both groupings
claim_limits: O composition is not globally associative by default
associativity claims must declare admissibility and residue context

grouping_equivalence_rules.name: o_grouping_equivalence_rule_v1
grouping_equivalence_rules.statement: Two O-composition groupings are equivalent only if they produce the same admissibility status, Ref(.) equivalence class, transition legality, and residue update eligibility.
